```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
# The report folder is its own small Quarto project, so tell here() where the
# real project root is (one level up), otherwise it would stop at report/
here::i_am("report/coastal_beginnings_report.qmd")
library(gt)
library(scales)

participants <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "participants.rds"))
qc_issues    <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "qc_issues.rds"))
scorecard_path <- here("data", "processed", "qc_scorecard.rds")
scorecard    <- if (file.exists(scorecard_path)) readRDS(scorecard_path) else NULL

# Colours: three validated categorical colours for the sites, plus neutral ink
site_colours <- c(
  "Coastal Community Clinic" = "#2a78d6",
  "Harbourview Hospital"     = "#eb6834",
  "Riverbend Midwifery"      = "#1baf7a"
)
ink       <- "#0b0b0b"
ink_soft  <- "#52514e"
grid_col  <- "#e6e5e1"
accent    <- "#2a78d6"

theme_report <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(colour = ink),
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = ink_soft),
      axis.title         = element_text(colour = ink_soft, size = 11),
      panel.grid.major   = element_line(colour = grid_col, linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = ink_soft),
      plot.caption       = element_text(colour = ink_soft, hjust = 0),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      legend.position    = "top",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )
}

n_enrolled <- nrow(participants)
n_tt       <- sum(participants$has_third_trimester)
n_birth    <- sum(participants$has_birth)
n_issues   <- nrow(qc_issues)
n_records_with_issues <- n_distinct(qc_issues$record_id)
```

::: {.callout-note}
This report is generated automatically from a REDCap project by the [REDCap starter kit](https://github.com/emmabranch/redcap-starter-kit). The study and every record in it are fictional, simulated for demonstration.
:::

## At a glance

```{r glance}
#| results: asis
tile <- function(value, label) {
  glue::glue('<div class="tile"><div class="tile-value">{value}</div><div class="tile-label">{label}</div></div>')
}
cat('<div class="tiles">',
    tile(n_enrolled, "participants enrolled"),
    tile(percent(n_tt / n_enrolled, 1), "completed the third trimester survey"),
    tile(percent(n_birth / n_enrolled, 1), "have a birth outcome recorded"),
    tile(n_issues, glue::glue("data issues to resolve, in {n_records_with_issues} records")),
    '</div>', sep = "\n")
```


## Recruitment

```{r recruitment}
#| fig-height: 4.5
recruit <- participants |>
  filter(!is.na(enrol_date), !is.na(site)) |>
  arrange(enrol_date) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  mutate(cumulative = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

end_labels <- recruit |>
  group_by(site) |>
  slice_max(enrol_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(recruit, aes(enrol_date, cumulative, colour = site)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = end_labels, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = end_labels, aes(label = paste0(site, " (", cumulative, ")")),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 6, size = 3.6, colour = ink) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = site_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.45))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative enrolment by site",
       subtitle = glue::glue("{n_enrolled} participants enrolled between {format(min(recruit$enrol_date), '%B %Y')} and {format(max(recruit$enrol_date), '%B %Y')}"),
       x = NULL, y = "Participants enrolled") +
  theme_report()
```

## Follow-up and form completion

```{r completeness}
completion <- tibble(
  Event = c("Enrolment", "Third trimester survey", "Birth outcome"),
  status = list(participants$enrolment_complete,
                participants$third_trimester_survey_complete,
                participants$birth_outcome_complete)
) |>
  mutate(
    Records    = map_int(status, \(x) sum(!is.na(x))),
    `Share of enrolled` = Records / n_enrolled,
    Complete   = map_int(status, \(x) sum(x == "Complete", na.rm = TRUE)),
    Unverified = map_int(status, \(x) sum(x == "Unverified", na.rm = TRUE)),
    Incomplete = map_int(status, \(x) sum(x == "Incomplete", na.rm = TRUE))
  ) |>
  select(-status)

completion |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_percent(`Share of enrolled`, decimals = 0) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Form status", columns = c(Complete, Unverified, Incomplete)) |>
  tab_source_note("Form status is set by data entry staff in REDCap. Incomplete forms usually have a required field left blank.") |>
  opt_row_striping()
```

## Data quality

```{r qc-intro}
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(scorecard)) {
  cat(glue::glue(
    "The quality checks flagged **{n_issues} issues** in **{n_records_with_issues} records**. ",
    "This synthetic dataset has {nrow(scorecard)} problems planted on purpose, and the checks caught ",
    "**{sum(scorecard$caught)} of {nrow(scorecard)}**. The extra flags are knock-on effects: one wrong date can trip more than one check."
  ))
}
```

```{r qc-summary}
qc_issues |>
  count(check, name = "Issues") |>
  right_join(tibble(check = c("Out of range", "Missing required field",
                              "Branching logic violation", "Date order",
                              "Implausible gestational age", "Possible duplicate")),
             by = "check") |>
  mutate(Issues = coalesce(Issues, 0L),
         `What it means` = case_when(
           check == "Out of range" ~ "Value outside the limits set in the data dictionary",
           check == "Missing required field" ~ "A required question was left blank",
           check == "Branching logic violation" ~ "A value sits in a question that should be hidden",
           check == "Date order" ~ "Dates across events are in an impossible order",
           check == "Implausible gestational age" ~ "Gestational age at birth outside 22 to 44 weeks",
           check == "Possible duplicate" ~ "Same person may be enrolled twice"
         )) |>
  rename(Check = check) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_align("right", Issues) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```

### Issues to resolve

The full list, ready to send to the study coordinator. It is also saved as `outputs/qc_issues.csv`.

```{r qc-detail}
qc_issues |>
  transmute(
    Record = record_id,
    Event  = recode(event,
                    enrolment_arm_1 = "Enrolment",
                    third_trimester_arm_1 = "Third trimester",
                    birth_arm_1 = "Birth"),
    Question = coalesce(field_label, field),
    Value  = coalesce(value, "(blank)"),
    Check  = check,
    Detail = detail
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  opt_interactive(use_search = TRUE, use_pagination = TRUE,
                  page_size_default = 10, use_compact_mode = TRUE)
```

## Participants at enrolment

Values are shown as entered. Records with open data issues are included, so a few figures may change once those are resolved.

```{r baseline}
baseline <- participants |>
  filter(!is.na(site)) |>
  group_by(Site = as.character(site)) |>
  summarise(
    Participants = n(),
    `Age, mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `BMI, median` = sprintf("%.1f", median(bmi, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `First pregnancy` = mean(parity == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Currently smokes` = mean(smoking == "Currently smokes", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Bachelor's degree or higher` = mean(education %in% c("Bachelor's degree", "Graduate degree"), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

baseline |>
  gt(rowname_col = "Site") |>
  fmt_percent(c(`First pregnancy`, `Currently smokes`, `Bachelor's degree or higher`), decimals = 0) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```

## Birth outcomes

Records flagged with an implausible gestational age or an out-of-range birth weight are left out of these figures until they are corrected.

```{r outcomes-data}
flagged_ga <- qc_issues |> filter(check %in% c("Implausible gestational age")) |> pull(record_id)
flagged_bw <- qc_issues |> filter(field == "birth_weight_g", check == "Out of range") |> pull(record_id)

births <- participants |>
  filter(has_birth, !is.na(ga_birth_weeks),
         !record_id %in% flagged_ga)
n_preterm <- sum(births$ga_birth_weeks < 37)
```

```{r ga-plot}
ggplot(births, aes(ga_birth_weeks)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = accent, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 37, linetype = "dashed", colour = ink_soft) +
  annotate("text", x = 36.8, y = Inf, label = "37 weeks", hjust = 1, vjust = 1.5,
           size = 3.6, colour = ink_soft) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(26, 44, 2)) +
  labs(title = "Gestational age at birth",
       subtitle = glue::glue("{n_preterm} of {nrow(births)} births ({percent(n_preterm / nrow(births), 0.1)}) were preterm"),
       x = "Completed weeks of gestation", y = "Births") +
  theme_report()
```

```{r bw-plot}
births_bw <- births |> filter(!is.na(birth_weight_g), !record_id %in% flagged_bw)

ggplot(births_bw, aes(ga_birth_weeks, birth_weight_g)) +
  geom_point(colour = accent, alpha = 0.55, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, colour = ink, fill = grid_col, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma(), breaks = seq(500, 5000, 500)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(26, 44, 2)) +
  labs(title = "Birth weight rises with gestational age",
       subtitle = "Each point is one birth; the line is a smoothed average",
       x = "Gestational age at birth (weeks)", y = "Birth weight (g)") +
  theme_report()
```

```{r delivery-plot}
#| fig-height: 3.2
delivery <- participants |>
  filter(has_birth, !is.na(delivery_mode), !is.na(gdm)) |>
  mutate(caesarean = delivery_mode %in% c("Planned caesarean", "Unplanned caesarean"),
         group = if_else(gdm == "Yes", "Gestational diabetes", "No gestational diabetes")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(caesarean))

ggplot(delivery, aes(rate, fct_reorder(group, rate))) +
  geom_col(fill = accent, width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = glue::glue("{percent(rate, 1)} of {n}")), hjust = -0.1,
            size = 3.8, colour = ink) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, max(delivery$rate) * 1.35),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Caesarean births by gestational diabetes status",
       x = "Share of births by caesarean", y = NULL) +
  theme_report() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
